# Core Rule 0 ## Players must be, and act, 18 or above to play Wolfgate.
[italic][color=#b8860b]If you are proven to be intentionally withholding information that a player is under 18 in Wolfgate, you may be banned under this rule.[/color][/italic]
- A player's real-life chronological age must be 18 years old to play the server. Secondly, [color=#b8860b]you must act as if you are 18 or above.[/color]
- Players with immature personalities [color=#d93c3c]can be removed with admin discretion under this rule.[/color]
